info.name: Last Opened Files
info.summary: Dashboard widget for recently opened files
info.description:
Tracks files opened in the web files app and shows the user's most recently opened files on the Nextcloud dashboard.
This app stores a small per-user file-open history in the existing Nextcloud database. The history is used only for the dashboard widget and is limited to the latest 100 files per user.
info.author: Sea-Watch
